STATE: MOC investor (reached out after basedspace Demo Day) meeting booked for Wednesday March 11 2026. They offered 'investing early, up to EUR 3M.'

NED'S FRAME: Not motivated about Whisnap specifically, but the meeting is a 30-min call, not a commitment. Strategy: let them talk half the time, pitch the founder (solo guy, marketer who learned to build) not just the product.

CALL CHEAT SHEET:
- What you built: voice-to-text that cleans messy speech, local free/cloud $10/mo, solo in 9 months
- Market validated: Wispr Flow raised $50M, you're one guy
- What you learned: launched, 10 users, distribution is the bottleneck
- Pivot: content-first, build-in-public
- What you'd use money for: time + distribution, not more building
- Flip questions: 'What stage do you invest at?' 'What made you reach out?'

NEXT: Investor prep if needed before Wednesday.
